entries.title: Egypt to Switch to Winter Time on October 30
entries.author: Farah Abbas
entries.summary: Egypt will turn clocks back by one hour at midnight on Thursday, 29 October, as daylight saving time comes to an end and the country returns to winter time on Friday, 30 October. The change will move clocks from 12:00 AM back to 11:00 PM on Thursday, giving residents an extra hour as the country transitions to standard time. Under Law No. 24 of 2023, daylight saving time begins on the last Friday…

entries.title: The nationalist dream reality is AI generated
entries.author: Sarah Waring
entries.summary: Quick, cheap, repetitive and effective – far-right AI-generated imagery is flooding the internet and social media. Behind the kitsch facade lie parallels to Nazi propaganda, only now mass-media image-making is available to all and insidious, as illustrated by a Slovakian grassroots movement.
